a: مَنْ بَنَى مَسْجِدًا لِلَّهِ كَمَفْحَصِ قَطَاةٍ أَوْ أَصْغَرَ بَنَى اللَّهُ لَهُ بَيْتًا فِي الْجَنَّةِ
p: Man banā masjidan lillāhi ka-mafḥaṣi qaṭātin aw aṣghar, bana-Llāhu lahu baytan fi-l-jannah
m: Whoever builds a mosque for Allah, even the size of a sandgrouse's scrape in the ground or smaller, Allah builds him a house in the Garden.
